correctness.rationale: For connected simple unweighted cacti the proof reduces to cycle blocks by affine-invariant free-sum Mahler multiplication. The cycle polar equals an inverse-difference image of a central cube section with determinant n, and the primal volume is computed by parity-dependent facet triangulations. The exact Irwin–Hall formula and Fourier/Laplace plus Stirling expansion prove the stated rational products and sharp first corrections. Twelve independent hull volume comparisons and exact rational checks passed; numerical tests do not substitute for infinite proof.
